📰 每日 AI 新聞 Top 10 · 2026-10-21
1. Anthropic's first-half revenue jumps nearly 15x, with an $80.7B net loss產業
Anthropic 上半年營收暴增近 15 倍，淨損 807 億美元
Anthropic's draft IPO filing, reported by the WSJ, shows H1 revenue of $16.3B, nearly 15x the year before. The net loss reached $80.7B, of which $72B is an accounting charge from changes in the value of financing instruments.
華爾街日報報導 Anthropic 的上市文件草案：上半年營收 163 億美元，約為去年同期的 15 倍。淨損 807 億美元，其中 720 億美元是融資工具價值變動的會計費用。
iThome · https://www.ithome.com.tw/news/179845
2. SpaceX turns profitable in Q3 as AI business revenue surges 830%產業
SpaceX 第三季轉虧為盈，AI 業務營收暴增 830%
SpaceX posted Q3 revenue of $14.58B, up 161%, and net income of $4.4B. Its Super Intelligence business grew 830% to $7.56B, overtaking Starlink as the largest revenue source.
SpaceX 第三季營收 145.8 億美元，年增 161%，淨利 44 億美元。超級智慧業務營收年增 830%，達 75.6 億美元，首度超越 Starlink 成為最大營收來源。
iThome · https://www.ithome.com.tw/news/179849
3. Anthropic's cloud partnerships are getting messy產業
Anthropic 的雲端合作關係變得棘手
Anthropic is reportedly struggling to secure enough compute from cloud providers that increasingly see it as a competitor. Its infrastructure spending is ballooning ahead of a planned November IPO.
據報導，雲端業者越來越把 Anthropic 視為競爭對手，使其難以取得足夠算力。在預計 11 月上市前，它的基礎設施支出也持續膨脹。
TechCrunch · https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/20/anthropics-cloud-partnerships-are-getting-messy/
4. OpenAI acquires Orchestra Bio to strengthen its biotech business產業
OpenAI 收購 Orchestra Bio 強化生物技術能力
OpenAI is adding Orchestra Bio's team and technology to Rosalind, its life-sciences AI model, and to the Rosalind Workbench tool. Orchestra's agentic platform helps pharma teams coordinate drug development.
OpenAI 將 Orchestra Bio 的團隊與技術併入生命科學模型 Rosalind 及 Rosalind Workbench 工具。Orchestra 的代理式平臺可協助藥廠協調複雜的藥物開發流程。
TechCrunch · https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/20/openai-acquires-startup-orchestra-bio%e2%81%a0-to-beef-up-its-biotech-business/
5. Google and Meta open-source TorchTPU to challenge Nvidia's dominance產品
Google、Meta 合作提供開源 TorchTPU，挑戰 Nvidia 獨霸地位
Google and Meta's PyTorch team released TorchTPU, an open-source stack that makes PyTorch easier to run on Google TPUs. Amazon has released a similar tool for its own chips.
Google 與 Meta 的 PyTorch 團隊公布開源軟體堆疊 TorchTPU，讓 PyTorch 更容易在 Google TPU 上執行。Amazon 也已為自家晶片推出類似工具。
iThome · https://www.ithome.com.tw/news/179847
6. Japanese firms hit in a string of attacks; GMO confirms attackers used AI pentest tool ARTEX資安
日本企業接連遭駭，GMO 確認攻擊者使用 AI 滲透測試工具 ARTEX
GMO Cybersecurity by Ierae confirmed that attackers used the autonomous AI pentest tool ARTEX against Japanese companies. Researchers also found six more AI-driven attack hosts targeting different industries.
GMO Cybersecurity by Ierae 確認攻擊者使用 AI 自主滲透測試工具 ARTEX 攻擊日本企業，並發現另外 6 臺使用 AI 技術的攻擊主機，各自鎖定不同產業。
iThome · https://www.ithome.com.tw/news/179850
7. AWS tests an AI agent exploiting vulnerabilities autonomously: 33 of 37 CVEs succeeded研究
AWS 測試 AI 代理自主尋找及利用漏洞，37 項 CVE 有 33 項成功
AWS Security Agent, running on Claude Opus 5, exploited 33 of 37 CVEs disclosed in 2025–2026, an 89.2% success rate. Each test was capped at 10 hours.
AWS Security Agent 使用 Claude Opus 5 模型，成功利用 2025 至 2026 年揭露的 37 項 CVE 中的 33 項，成功率 89.2%，每項測試時間上限為 10 小時。
iThome · https://www.ithome.com.tw/news/179744
8. Meta pauses Muse sharing after researchers find AI chats on the web資安
Meta 在研究人員發現 AI 對話公開於網路後暫停 Muse 分享功能
Meta paused Muse's conversation-sharing feature after security firm Claroc found more than 6,800 shared links publicly available on the web. Meta is investigating the privacy issue.
資安公司 Claroc 發現超過 6,800 個 Muse 分享連結可在網路上公開取得，Meta 因此暫停對話分享功能，並調查隱私問題。
The Verge · https://www.theverge.com/tech/1014627/meta-muse-ai-sharing-ai-chats
9. US orders federal agencies to remove China's DeepSeek AI from their systems政策
美國下令聯邦機關移除中國 DeepSeek AI
The US ordered federal civilian agencies to remove DeepSeek products and third-party services built on its technology, citing national security concerns.
美國以國家安全為由，下令聯邦文職機關移除 DeepSeek 產品，以及採用其技術的第三方服務。
TechCrunch · https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/20/us-orders-federal-agencies-to-remove-chinas-deepseek-ai-from-their-systems/
10. OpenAI releases MultiLangBench to test coding across 20 programming languages模型
OpenAI 釋出 AI 基準測試 MultiLangBench，評測 20 種程式語言開發能力
The benchmark asks AI to build a SQLite-compatible database engine from scratch in 20 languages, including low-resource ones like COBOL, Fortran and Visual Basic, as well as Python, Java and Rust.
此基準要求 AI 以 20 種語言從頭建立與 SQLite 相容的資料庫引擎，涵蓋 COBOL、Fortran、Visual Basic 等資料較少的語言，也包括 Python、Java 與 Rust。
iThome · https://www.ithome.com.tw/news/179840
